articles.title_en: AgriLOVE: Agriculture, land-use and technical change in an evolutionary, agent-based model
articles.title_cn: AgriLOVE：一个演化、基于主体的农业、土地利用与技术变迁模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a dynamic agent-based model of land use and agricultural production under environmental boundaries, finite available resources and endogenous technical change. In particular, we model a spatially explicit smallholder farming system populated by boundedly-rational agents competing and innovating to fulfill an exogenous demand for food, while coping with a changing environment shaped by their production choices. Given the strong technological and environmental uncertainty, agents learn and adaptively employ heuristics which guide their decisions on engaging in innovation and imitation activities, hiring workers, acquiring new farms, deforesting virgin areas and abandoning unproductive lands. Such activities in turn impact farm productivity, food production, food prices and land use. We firstly show that the model can replicate key stylized facts of the agricultural sector. We then extensively explore its properties across several scenarios featuring different institutional and behavioral settings. Finally, we simulate the model across different applications considering deforestation and land abandonment; human-induced soil degradation; and climate impacts. AgriLOVE offers a flexible simulation environment to study the endogenous emergence of different agricultural production regimes from the interaction of spatially dispersed farms subject to resource constraints, spatial influence and climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个在环境边界、有限可用资源和内生技术变迁条件下，关于土地利用和农业生产的动态基于主体模型。具体而言，我们模拟了一个空间显式的小农耕作系统，其中居住着有限理性的主体，他们在应对由其生产选择所塑造的不断变化的环境的同时，竞争和创新以满足外生的粮食需求。鉴于强烈的技术和环境不确定性，主体学习并自适应地采用启发式规则，这些规则指导他们在参与创新和模仿活动、雇佣工人、获取新农场、砍伐原始区域和放弃低产土地方面的决策。这些活动反过来又影响农场生产力、粮食生产、粮食价格和土地利用。我们首先表明该模型能够复现农业部门的关键典型事实。然后，我们在具有不同制度和行为设置的多个情景中广泛探索其特性。最后，我们在考虑森林砍伐和土地弃耕、人为引起的土壤退化以及气候影响的不同应用中模拟该模型。AgriLOVE提供了一个灵活的模拟环境，用于研究受资源约束、空间影响和气候变化影响的空间分散农场相互作用下，不同农业生产制度的内生涌现。

articles.title_en: Trends in household demand and greenhouse gas footprints in Germany: Evidence from microdata of the last 20 years
articles.title_cn: 德国家庭需求与温室气体足迹的趋势：来自过去20年微观数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies changes in the trend of greenhouse gas footprints associated with household consumption covering a period of 20 years. We combine greenhouse gas emissions related to the supply chain (embedded) and consumption (direct) with households' consumption expenditures from the sample survey of income and expenditure (EVS), and present the first comprehensive study on trends in greenhouse gas footprints of German households. We find a decay in changes in GHG footprints as a response to increases in household expenditure over time. In addition, our estimated own-price elasticities for electricity and heating indicate an increasing demand response to higher energy prices. However, this does not translate to a clear decreasing trend in the total GHG footprint because of the role of changes in the demand of other commodities and changes in expenditure levels across years. Further, comparing results of the more advanced EASI demand system with those of the more widely used QUAIDS approach, we find sizable differences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了覆盖20年期间与家庭消费相关的温室气体足迹趋势的变化。我们将供应链（隐含）和消费（直接）相关的温室气体排放与来自收支样本调查（EVS）的家庭消费支出相结合，并呈现了首项关于德国家庭温室气体足迹趋势的全面研究。我们发现，随着时间的推移，温室气体足迹对家庭支出增加的响应呈衰减趋势。此外，我们估计的电力和供暖的自价格弹性表明，对更高能源价格的需求响应在增加。然而，由于其他商品需求变化和跨年支出水平变化的作用，这并未转化为总温室气体足迹的明确下降趋势。进一步，将更先进的EASI需求系统与更广泛使用的QUAIDS方法的结果进行比较，我们发现存在显著差异。

articles.title_en: Tracing embodied energy use through global value chains: Channel decomposition and analysis of influential factors
articles.title_cn: 追踪全球价值链中的隐含能源使用：渠道分解与影响因素分析
articles.abstract_en: Measurement of the energy use dispersed through international trade is crucial in the age of global value chains. This study traces international energy flows, presents the stylized facts, and analyses the major driving factors of energy flows. The findings of this study show that 20% of global energy is transmitted through global value chains and there is large energy imbalance between economies. The gravity model illustrates that energy transfers between home and host countries increase with economic size, a shared border, a same language, and a similar legal system, and decrease with geographic distance. However, distance is becoming less significant in transmitting energy due to the increasing complexity of global value chains. Global value chains have altered how the world consumes energy directly and indirectly, thus must be taken into consideration by both environmental and trade policies aiming at encouraging sustainable development, equity, and energy conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在全球价值链时代，衡量通过国际贸易分散的能源使用至关重要。本研究追踪了国际能源流动，呈现了典型事实，并分析了能源流动的主要驱动因素。研究结果表明，全球能源的20%通过全球价值链传输，且各经济体之间存在巨大的能源不平衡。引力模型显示，母国与东道国之间的能源转移随着经济规模、共同边界、相同语言和相似法律体系的增加而增加，并随着地理距离的增加而减少。然而，由于全球价值链日益复杂，距离在能源传输中的重要性正在减弱。全球价值链改变了世界直接和间接消费能源的方式，因此，旨在促进可持续发展、公平和节能的环境政策和贸易政策都必须将其考虑在内。

articles.title_en: Unlocking the potential of income and wealth caps in post-growth transformation: A framework for improving policy design
articles.title_cn: 释放后增长转型中收入与财富上限的潜力：一个改进政策设计的框架
articles.abstract_en: Preventing the increase of economic inequality in a non-growing economy is a major challenge. In post-growth research, scholars agree that reducing the income and assets of the wealthy must be part of any strategy for reducing inequality. Nevertheless, caps on wealth and income remain surprisingly under-researched. After discussing the role of these caps in post-growth transformation, this paper aims to fill this gap by exploring the main parameters that policymakers need to consider when designing caps on income or assets. We performed a qualitative content analysis of 14 policy proposals, including four historical cases. We then built an analytical framework with seven key parameters. This framework reveals a broad set of public policies that policymakers and researchers can consider, including new options for wealth caps. We furthermore discuss how such policies should be designed to increase public support, and we highlight recurring patterns about the context in which they were proposed. We also show how these radical solutions reduced economic inequality in the 20th century in western countries and how policymakers can draw on those examples to design post-growth policies that decrease inequality and are also popular.
articles.abstract_cn: 在非增长经济中防止经济不平等加剧是一项重大挑战。在后增长研究中，学者们一致认为，减少富人的收入和资产必须是任何减少不平等战略的一部分。然而，对财富和收入上限的研究却出奇地少。在讨论了这些上限在后增长转型中的作用之后，本文旨在通过探索政策制定者在设计收入或资产上限时需要考虑的主要参数来填补这一空白。我们对14项政策提案进行了定性内容分析，包括四个历史案例。然后，我们构建了一个包含七个关键参数的分析框架。该框架揭示了政策制定者和研究人员可以考虑的一系列广泛的公共政策，包括财富上限的新选项。我们还讨论了如何设计这些政策以增加公众支持，并强调了关于它们被提出的背景的反复出现的模式。我们还展示了这些激进解决方案如何在20世纪减少了西方国家的经济不平等，以及政策制定者如何借鉴这些例子来设计既能减少不平等又受欢迎的后期增长政策。

articles.title_en: Optimal post-border surveillance against invasive pests to protect a valuable nature reserve and island asset
articles.title_cn: 针对入侵性害虫的最优边境后监测以保护珍贵的自然保护区与岛屿资产
articles.abstract_en: Harmful and often catastrophic damages from the introduction of non-indigenous species (NIS) are widely acknowledged. While preventing the introduction of NIS through border and pre-border measures has been the first line of defence, post-border surveillance has recently attracted considerable attention as it increases the likelihood that small invasive populations will be found and eradicated quickly before they become widespread. We develop a novel and practical optimal surveillance model across space and a number of surveillance techniques for four different invasive pests, determining where and how to best allocate resources to detect and eradicate these pests. Our focus is on Barrow Island, a Class A Nature Reserve in Australia, home to thousands of native plants and animals, many endemic to the island, where limited industrial activity and environmental protection coexist. It is also home to the world's largest non-government quarantine and surveillance system. Our results provide a unique platform that finds the maximum net benefit from post-border surveillance expenditures across species, locations, and surveillance methods, thus protecting a key environmental asset.
articles.abstract_cn: 非本地物种（NIS）引入所带来的有害且往往是灾难性的损害已被广泛认识。虽然通过边境和边境前措施防止NIS引入是第一道防线，但边境后监测近年来引起了相当大的关注，因为它增加了小型入侵种群在被广泛扩散前被发现并迅速根除的可能性。我们开发了一个新颖且实用的最优监测模型，涵盖空间和多种监测技术，针对四种不同的入侵性害虫，确定在何处以及如何最优地分配资源以检测和根除这些害虫。我们的重点是巴罗岛，澳大利亚的A级自然保护区，拥有数千种本土植物和动物，其中许多是该岛特有的，有限的工业活动和环境保护在这里共存。它也是世界上最大的非政府检疫和监测系统的所在地。我们的结果提供了一个独特的平台，能够从物种、地点和监测方法的角度找到边境后监测支出的最大净收益，从而保护这一关键的环境资产。

articles.title_en: Socioecological transformations at the specialized productive space in coffee and sugarcane in the context of the Green Revolution. Costa Rica (1955–1973)
articles.title_cn: 绿色革命背景下咖啡和甘蔗专业化生产空间的社会生态转型：哥斯达黎加（1955-1973）
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new evidence on the energy balances and energy returns of the agricultural systems specialized in coffee and sugarcane (SPS_CS) in Costa Rica between 1955 and 1973, during the peak of the Green Revolution. The analysis is developed in the Costa Rican region of that the 1955 Agricultural Census characterized as specialized in these productions of coffee and sugarcane and using the concept of Specialized Productive Spaces (SPS) developed by the researchers. Based on this regionalization as system boundaries, the authors proposed carrying out a retrospective historical analysis (1955 and 1973) to show, from the Social Metabolism approach and the multi-Energy Return on Investment (multi-EROI) accountings, the different exchanges of experience in the material and energy flows interlinking the agroecosystem funds and functioning and materials from a historical perspective. The findings suggest that this Costa Rican productive space (SPS_CS) presents moved from an agroecosystem with low energy efficiency in energy terms in 1955 that tended to improve towards an improved one in 1973, contrary to what happened in other countries of the Global North though only in the socioeconomic flows, which does not imply that the bioconversion chains have not been simplified. Results also conclude that subsistence mixed cropping may have contributed to a slower deterioration of energy efficiency in the SPS_CS. Other agroecological energy indicators more potentially related to farm-associated biodiversity show the other side of the coin: increased agrifood yields through a reduction in the total amount of photosynthesized biomass, in reused biomass by farmers, and in recirculated biomass through direct intake by non-domesticated species. As these internal recirculating flows help reproduce the living funds of agroecosystems, their contraction undermined nature-based ecosystem services that were replaced by an increase in external industrial inputs that, even as they grew, in those Costa Rican areas still held up comparatively low in the total energy throughput.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了1955年至1973年间绿色革命高峰期哥斯达黎加咖啡和甘蔗专业化农业系统（SPS_CS）能量平衡和能量回报的新证据。分析在哥斯达黎加地区进行，该地区在1955年农业普查中被定性为咖啡和甘蔗专业化生产区，并使用了研究人员提出的专业化生产空间（SPS）概念。基于这一区域化作为系统边界，作者提出进行回顾性历史分析（1955年和1973年），从社会代谢方法和多重能源回报率（multi-EROI）核算的角度，展示农业生态系统资金和功能与材料之间物质和能量流动的不同交换经验。研究结果表明，这一哥斯达黎加生产空间（SPS_CS）在1955年是一个能量效率较低的农业生态系统，到1973年趋于改善，这与全球北方其他国家的情况相反，但仅限于社会经济流动方面，这并不意味着生物转化链没有被简化。结果还表明，自给性混合种植可能有助于减缓SPS_CS能量效率的恶化。其他与农场相关生物多样性更可能相关的农业生态能量指标显示了另一面：农业食品产量的增加是通过减少光合作用生物质总量、农民再利用的生物质以及非驯化物种直接摄入的再循环生物质来实现的。由于这些内部再循环流动有助于再生产农业生态系统的生命资金，它们的收缩削弱了基于自然的生态系统服务，而这些服务被外部工业投入的增加所取代，尽管这些投入在增长，但在那些哥斯达黎加地区，它们在总能量吞吐量中仍然相对较低。

articles.title_en: Stochastic growth and regime shift risk in renewable resource management
articles.title_cn: 可再生资源管理中的随机增长与制度转换风险
articles.abstract_en: Renewable resources are affected by both environmental variability, which makes the year-to-year stock growth uncertain, and the risk of irreversible events (e.g., a stock collapse). Little is known about how a renewable resource harvester would optimally respond to the combined effects of both sources of risk. In this paper, we propose a simple dynamic resource model to investigate this issue. For some structures of the harvesting cost function, we find that anticipating a higher variability in biological growth induces a cautious management policy, but only when regime shift risk is accounted for. Accounting for the risk of regime shift may prescribe large changes in management responses to anticipated random changes in biological growth whereas ignoring such a risk prescribes small changes in management. Optimal escapement is not constant but varies across all periods when the planning horizon is finite and the regime shift risk is endogenous.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生资源同时受到环境变异性和不可逆事件（如资源崩溃）风险的影响，前者使得年际资源存量增长不确定，后者则带来不可逆事件的风险。关于可再生资源开采者如何最优地应对这两种风险来源的联合效应，目前知之甚少。本文提出了一个简单的动态资源模型来研究这一问题。对于某些开采成本函数结构，我们发现，预期生物增长变异性更高会诱发谨慎的管理政策，但仅在考虑制度转换风险时如此。考虑制度转换风险可能会规定管理对预期生物增长随机变化的响应发生较大变化，而忽略这种风险则规定管理变化较小。当规划期有限且制度转换风险为内生时，最优逃逸量并非恒定，而是在所有时期均有所变化。

articles.title_en: Pulp and participation: Assessing the legitimacy of participatory environmental governance in Umkomaas, South Africa
articles.title_cn: 纸浆与参与：评估南非乌姆科马斯参与式环境治理的合法性
articles.abstract_en: The Sappi Saiccor mill in Umkomaas, KwaZulu Natal (KZN) Province, is a global pulp producer. It is also a major emitter of noxious substances in the heavily polluted and historically marginalised South Durban area. Taking a qualitative, narrative approach, this paper examines Saiccor's legacy of contamination, community opposition to the mill, and responses of state actors responsible for governing industrial risk. Through a conceptual framework combining theories around participatory environmental governance, legitimacy and state capture, the article explores the extent to which measures deployed by/on behalf of the Sappi Saiccor mill to engage with local residents and activists can be considered legitimate. The paper argues that prevalent corporate instrumentalism and a lack of political will continue to undermine the legitimacy of community engagement processes, which remain characterised by mistrust. It concludes the South African state cannot be relied upon to support genuinely inclusive, deliberative, empowering and reflexive governance practices. It is therefore left to organised civil society to force discourse beyond hegemonic, ecologically-modernised, technocentric ideals, and to bring issues of power, agency, and social justice to the fore of public and policy debate. The way might then be paved for strong political leadership committed to transparent, equitable environmental governance processes.
articles.abstract_cn: 位于夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省乌姆科马斯的Sappi Saiccor工厂是全球纸浆生产商，同时也是污染严重且历史上被边缘化的南德班地区有害物质的主要排放者。本文采用定性、叙事的方法，考察了Saiccor的污染遗留问题、社区对该工厂的反对，以及负责管理工业风险的政府行为者的回应。通过结合参与式环境治理、合法性和国家俘获理论的 conceptual 框架，文章探讨了由Sappi Saiccor工厂或其代表所采取的与当地居民和活动家接触的措施在多大程度上可以被视为合法。本文认为，普遍存在的企业工具主义和缺乏政治意愿继续削弱社区参与过程的合法性，这些过程仍以不信任为特征。结论是，不能指望南非国家支持真正包容、协商、赋权和反思性的治理实践。因此，有组织的公民社会必须迫使话语超越霸权、生态现代化、技术中心的理想，并将权力、能动性和社会正义问题带到公共和政策辩论的前沿。这样，才能为致力于透明、公平的环境治理过程的强有力的政治领导铺平道路。

articles.title_en: Anti-corruption and corporate pollution mitigation: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 反腐败与企业污染减排：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Corruption is considered to be a major cause of increased pollution. However, little research has focused on the micro-environmental consequences of political initiatives aimed at curbing corruption, such as anti-corruption campaigns. Based on data from Chinese industrial enterprises, we investigate the impact of anti-corruption on corporate pollution mitigation. Our findings show that China's powerful anti-corruption campaign launched in 2013 has considerably reduced the pollution emission intensity of firms colluding with the government. The mechanism analysis suggests that the anti-corruption campaign has driven firms to mitigate pollution via the hardening effect of environmental regulation, the promotion effect of the market incentive function, and the optimization effect of corporate resource allocation. These findings provide important theoretical and practical value for environmental governance practices in nations like China.
articles.abstract_cn: 腐败被认为是污染加剧的主要原因之一。然而，很少有研究关注旨在遏制腐败的政治举措（如反腐败运动）的微观环境后果。基于中国工业企业数据，我们研究了反腐败对企业污染减排的影响。我们的研究结果表明，中国于2013年发起的强有力的反腐败运动显著降低了与政府勾结的企业的污染排放强度。机制分析表明，反腐败运动通过环境规制的硬化效应、市场激励功能的促进效应以及企业资源配置的优化效应，推动企业减少污染。这些发现为中国等国家的环境治理实践提供了重要的理论和实践价值。

articles.title_en: Directors' and officers' liability insurance, environmental regulation and firms' envi ronmental responsibility
articles.title_cn: 董事及高管责任保险、环境规制与企业环境责任
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the relationship among directors' and officers' liability insurance (D&O Insurance), environmental regulation, and firms' environmental responsibility-taking. Using the data on firms' green innovation achievement and environmental protection investment from China, where the information of D&O Insurance purchases was disclosed, we find robust evidence that insured firms significantly promote firms' environmental responsibility-taking, evident in more green innovation achievement and environmental protection investment. This positive association is more pronounced for firms exposed to stronger environmental regulation. In addition, we document that the moderating effect of environmental regulation is stronger for SOEs, firms with better corporate governance, operating in heavy-polluting industries, and exposed to a stronger institutional environment. Further mechanism analysis shows that public supervision is the underlying channel through which D&O Insurance affects firms' environmental responsibility. Overall, our findings imply that D&O Insurance, one of the important corporate governance mechanisms, motivates directors and officers to actively practice firms' environmental responsibility, and environmental regulation exerts a positive influence over this governance effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了董事及高管责任保险（D&O保险）、环境规制与企业环境责任承担之间的关系。利用中国披露D&O保险购买信息的企业绿色创新成果和环保投资数据，我们发现了稳健的证据表明，投保企业显著促进了企业环境责任的承担，体现在更多的绿色创新成果和环保投资上。这种正相关关系在面临更强环境规制的企业中更为显著。此外，我们记录了环境规制的调节效应在国有企业、公司治理较好的企业、重污染行业企业以及制度环境较强的企业中更为明显。进一步的机制分析表明，公众监督是D&O保险影响企业环境责任的潜在渠道。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，D&O保险作为重要的公司治理机制之一，激励董事和高管积极践行企业环境责任，而环境规制对这一治理效应产生了积极影响。

articles.title_en: Citizens' preferences and valuation of urban nature: Insights from two choice experiments
articles.title_cn: 市民对城市自然的偏好与价值评估：来自两个选择实验的见解
articles.abstract_en: Urban nature increases the liveability of cities and can improve their resilience to climate change. However, the value of urban nature often remains unknown, which results in its omission from urban planning decisions. Particularly the valuation of small-sized urban nature remains understudied. This study therefore employs a stated preference methodology to estimate the economic value of seven types of small urban nature and four associated ecosystem services. We perform two choice experiments: one with urban parks, urban forest and green corridors and another one with even smaller urban nature types (green roofs, green walls, street trees and green beds). The results of the choice analysis show that urban residents are willing to pay more for the former types of urban nature but not for the latter types. Urban parks are valued the most, followed by urban forests and green corridors. Within the category of the smallest urban nature types, street trees are valued most followed by green beds, whereas green walls and green roofs are least valued. We discuss opportunities and barriers to implementing economic valuation results in urban planning practices. Several policy and future research recommendations are proposed.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市自然提高了城市的宜居性，并能增强其对气候变化的韧性。然而，城市自然的价值往往未知，导致其在城市规划决策中被忽视。特别是小型城市自然的价值评估研究不足。因此，本研究采用陈述偏好方法，估算七种小型城市自然及四种相关生态系统服务的经济价值。我们进行了两个选择实验：一个涉及城市公园、城市森林和绿色廊道，另一个涉及更小型的城市自然类型（绿色屋顶、绿色墙壁、街道树木和绿色花坛）。选择分析结果显示，城市居民愿意为前一类城市自然支付更多，但不愿为后一类支付。城市公园价值最高，其次是城市森林和绿色廊道。在最小型城市自然类别中，街道树木价值最高，其次是绿色花坛，而绿色墙壁和绿色屋顶价值最低。我们讨论了在经济评估结果应用于城市规划实践中的机遇与障碍，并提出了若干政策和未来研究建议。

articles.title_en: Attitudinal drivers of home bias in public preferences for transboundary nature protected areas
articles.title_cn: 公众对跨界自然保护区的偏好中本土偏好的态度驱动因素
articles.abstract_en: We assess what drives the lower valuation of nature protection on the other side of the border in two European transboundary nature areas, the Białowieża Forest (Poland and Belarus), and Fulufjället (Norway and Sweden). Applying hybrid choice modelling, we account for people's attitudes when eliciting their preferences for extensions of transboundary nature protected areas. We examine the impact of attitudes on a so-called ‘home bias’ effect appearing in public preferences stated towards transboundary nature protected areas; that is the inclination towards preferring the domestic part. We find that concerning the intention of visiting the foreign part of the transboundary area, the appreciation of transboundary justice and altruism are the main systematic mitigators of home bias. Suspicious attitude towards the neighbouring country, the anticipation of unilateral foreign provision, and the manifestations of ‘patriotism’ apply as home bias drivers only to a limited degree. Facilitating visits to the foreign part by enhancing cross-border access can be expected to shift peoples' preferences towards transboundary co-operation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了在欧洲两个跨界自然区域，即比亚沃维耶扎森林（波兰和白俄罗斯）与富卢夫耶尔（挪威和瑞典），对边界另一侧自然保护价值评估较低的原因。通过应用混合选择模型，我们在引出人们对跨界自然保护区扩展的偏好时考虑了人们的态度。我们考察了态度对出现在公众对跨界自然保护区陈述偏好中的所谓“本土偏好”效应的影响；即倾向于偏好国内部分的倾向。我们发现，关于访问跨界区域外国部分的意图，对跨界正义和利他主义的欣赏是本土偏好的主要系统性缓解因素。对邻国的怀疑态度、对单方面外国供给的预期以及“爱国主义”的表现仅在一定程度上作为本土偏好的驱动因素。通过增强跨境通道来促进对外国部分的访问，可以预期将人们的偏好转向跨界合作。

articles.title_en: Insurance value of biodiversity in the Anthropocene is the full resilience value
articles.title_cn: 人类世中生物多样性的保险价值即完整的韧性价值
articles.abstract_en: Recently two distinctly different conceptualisations of insurance value of biodiversity/ ecosystems have been developed. The ecosystem framing addresses the full resilience value without singling out subjective risk preferences. Conversely, the economic framing focuses exactly on this subjective value of risk aversion, implying that the insurance value is zero for risk neutral persons. Here we analyse the differences conceptually and empirically, and relate this to the broader socio-cultural dimensions of social-ecological resilience. The uncertainty of the Anthropocene blurs the distinction between subjective/objective. We show that the economic framing has been operationalised only in specific cases while the broader literature on resilience, disaster risk reduction, and nature-based solutions tend to address the full value of resilience. Yet, the empirical literature that relates to insurance value of biodiversity is hardly consistent with resilience theory because the slow underlying variables defining resilience are rarely addressed. We suggest how the empirical literature on insurance value can be better aligned with resilience theory. Since the ecosystem framing of insurance value captures the essence of the resilience, we propose using the concept “resilience value” as it may reduce the present ambiguity in terminology and conceptualisation of insurance value of biodiversity.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期，关于生物多样性/生态系统保险价值出现了两种截然不同的概念化。生态系统框架关注完整的韧性价值，而不单独考虑主观风险偏好。相反，经济框架则恰恰聚焦于这种风险厌恶的主观价值，意味着对于风险中性的人来说，保险价值为零。这里我们从概念上和实证上分析这些差异，并将其与社会-生态韧性的更广泛社会文化维度联系起来。人类世的不确定性模糊了主观/客观之间的区别。我们表明，经济框架仅在特定案例中被操作化，而关于韧性、灾害风险减少和基于自然的解决方案的更广泛文献往往关注韧性的完整价值。然而，与生物多样性保险价值相关的实证文献几乎与韧性理论不一致，因为定义韧性的缓慢潜在变量很少被涉及。我们建议如何使保险价值的实证文献更好地与韧性理论对齐。由于保险价值的生态系统框架捕捉了韧性的本质，我们建议使用“韧性价值”这一概念，因为它可能减少当前在生物多样性保险价值的术语和概念化上的模糊性。
